chunks.text: ApexBio Dynamics is an advanced biotechnology and neuro-engineering company headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts. Founded in 2018 by bioengineer Dr. Arthur Pendelton, the company recruited Dr. Elena Vance in November 2021 as Chief AI Neuroscientist to lead the Autonomous Neural Systems Division.

ApexBio's hardware flagship is the NeuroPlex Bridge, a high-density micro-electrode array implant designed for bio-compatible deep brain interface. In June 2024, ApexBio Dynamics established a formal clinical research partnership with St. Jude Neurological Institute to evaluate invasive AI-driven neural modulation protocols in human subjects.

Dr. Elena Vance developed CerebroSync AI, an edge-computed deep reinforcement learning framework that interfaces directly with the NeuroPlex Bridge. CerebroSync AI processes multi-channel local field potentials from the subthalamic nucleus and predicts pathological oscillatory tremor synchronization 120ms before onset.

The primary therapeutic target of CerebroSync AI is Refractory Parkinson's Disease in patients who no longer respond effectively to levodopa therapy. In pre-clinical trials, CerebroSync AI demonstrated an 84% reduction in off-target involuntary movements.

Clinical Trial NCT-09428 is sponsored by ApexBio Dynamics and conducted at St. Jude Neurological Institute in Chicago. Dr. Marcus Thorne, Chief of Clinical Neurology at St. Jude, serves as Principal Investigator, supervising surgical implantation and patient telemetry.

Trial NCT-09428 evaluates the CerebroSync AI neuromodulation system embedded within the NeuroPlex Bridge for treating Refractory Parkinson's Disease. In October 2025, the U.S. FDA granted Breakthrough Device Designation to the integrated CerebroSync AI and NeuroPlex system.
